name: loom
description: Shared long-term memory and code intelligence for Claude Code, self-hosted on ClickHouse. MCP tools to save and recall decisions, preferences and corrections across sessions and teammates; lifecycle hooks that capture each session with no model call; a code index that answers where-is, who-calls and blast-radius questions with line-accurate units instead of whole-file reads.

server_url.title: Loom server URL
server_url.description: Where the Loom control plane answers (no trailing slash). Leave the default to use $LOOM_BASE_URL, else http://localhost:7777.

token.title: Loom token (JWT)
token.description: A writer token from Settings → Tokens in the dashboard, `loom mint-token`, or `loom init --agent`. Leave empty to use $LOOM_API_KEY, ~/.loom/config.json or ~/.loom/token.

toolset.title: MCP toolset
toolset.description: Which Loom tools the session lists: `coding` (default — memory, code tools, duplicate check, bisect candidates, PR check, blast radius) or a `+` union such as `coding+tracker` for the whole tracker plane. Every op stays callable by name.

local_first.title: Local-first code search
local_first.description: Off by default. On: search the working tree with grep/Read and use the code index only when this checkout is exactly at the indexed commit (LOOM_CODE_LOCAL_FIRST=on does the same).

code_repo.title: Code index repository
code_repo.description: Optional. A repository (owner/name such as ClickHouse/loom, or just its name when one readable repository has it) whose Loom code index the session uses when it is outside any git checkout, or when the checkout's own repository has no index. Inside an indexed checkout that checkout's index still wins; pass a namespace to a loom_code_* call to search another repository. LOOM_CODE_REPO does the same.
